PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

scalability, load balancing, and event-driven architectures, with strong production debugging experience. Experienced in Agile Scrum, working in 
sprint-based development with story estimation, sprint planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

● Generated freight bills and shipping labels via ZPL, and implemented fuel-price and carrier-discount business rules. 
● Used PostgreSQL for transactional data and Cassandra for high-volume tracking events; managed schema migrations. 
● Applied dependency injection (samber/do) to reduce coupling; wrote unit/integration tests using a TDD approach.
